title: Schedule recent activity strip
lede: The Schedule chrome no longer leads with standing Crew needed / Gear gaps / Data quality badges or full-width combine and unreleased-crew banners. It shows recent crew and calendar changes, with those exceptions as quiet rows.

sections.heading: Visual comparison
sections.note: Not a matched pair. The before image is the operator crop of the noisy chrome on 2026-09-18. The after captures are authenticated local Preview at 127.0.0.1:3000/schedule as Erik Role ADMIN. Viewports and page chrome differ; do not treat pixel deltas as measured.

shots.title: Noisy banners and badges
shots.cap: Combine banner, destructive unreleased-crew Alert, and Crew needed 817 / Gear gaps 165 / Data quality 268 on the default strip.

shots.title: Quiet recent activity
shots.cap: Recent activity lists the unreleased Hockey crew, the Cross Country combine suggestion, and newest calendar sync rows. Standing queue totals are gone from the default strip.

shots.cap: Scrolling into later September keeps Recent activity pinned. Jump to today appears because today left the timeline viewport.

shots.cap: Operator crop of the expanded Recent activity list before quiet badges and sync filtering.

shots.title: Quiet badges by default

shots.title: Red/green schedule diffs
shots.cap: Opening Schedule updates shows time and date moves with old values struck in red and new values in green. TV and promo-label noise are gone.

changes.h: Default strip is activity, not standing queues
changes.was: Tone-sorted badges capped at three, so Crew needed / Gear gaps / Data quality occupied the chrome on every visit.
changes.now: Newest crew and calendar-sync rows occupy the strip. Queue totals stay in Details.

changes.was: A full-width orange combine banner and a destructive Alert for every unreleased crew sat above the list.
changes.now: One unreleased-crew row and one combine row share the activity list, with Review still opening the existing crew sheet or combine preview.

changes.h: The strip sits above the scroll block
changes.was: Recent activity lived in the document flow above the list, so a today-anchored timeline hid it until you scrolled to the oldest events.
changes.now: It pins with the title and filters. Day headers and the today anchor measure the combined sticky bottom, so the timeline runs underneath.

changes.was: Expanded sync rows were plain text from → to lines.
changes.now: Old values are struck in red and new values are green, matching ActivityTimeline field diffs.
